subject: Approval request: contributor credits for OpenMap cohort
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@openmap.org>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: contributor credits for OpenMap contributor cloud cohort

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the earlier meetup — OpenMap's contributor cohort kicks off next month and we'd like to provide participating volunteers with low-friction access to Redwood for a set of hands-on workshops. Can Redwood issue a small trial grant for the cohort (roughly 8 contributors) to cover development usage for 3 months?

Estimated usage: ~150k tokens per contributor over 3 months (bursty during labs). Ideal is a single pooled credit bucket we can share via the self-serve portal or promo codes. If there's any standard OSS maintainer program form/criteria we should complete, point me there and we'll fill it out.

Relevant links: https://hub.openmap.org/projects/openmap-contrib

Thanks — happy to provide more details or a short call.

Cheers,
Samira
Samira Khan
Program Lead, OpenMap Foundation
samira@openmap.org
[OpenMap: openmap.org]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@openmap.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: contributor credits for OpenMap contributor cloud cohort

Hi Samira — great to hear, and congrats on the cohort launch.

Quick answers: we have a community grants process that supports pooled credit buckets and 3-month trial extensions. For cohorts of this size we generally issue a single bucket and a promo code for distribution; anything >$2k equivalent we route through a short approvals step.

I've attached our one-page request form and a proposed allocation (first pass): 8 contributors x 150k tokens = 1.2M tokens total; propose issuing 1.5M token-equivalent credits to allow for workshop bursts.

Next steps:
- If you confirm the allocation, I'll route for internal approval (ccing Community lead).
- If approved, we'll generate a single promo code and a pooled account you can manage.

Attachment: [attachment: oss_grant_form.pdf (application/pdf)]

Best,
Mina Haddad
Community Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: contributor credits for OpenMap contributor cloud cohort

Thanks Mina — reviewed the requested amount. Approve issuing a pooled promo for OpenMap Foundation at the proposed 1.5M token-equivalent level. Two operational notes:

1) Split issuance into two tranches: 1M now, 0.5M as a top-up after month 1 if utilization looks reasonable. This limits waste and lets us check for noisy consumption patterns.
2) Require a short post-mortem report (1 pager) after the 3 months describing usage and any quality/regression notes. That helps our Optimize team and supports future renewals.

I'll add a short approval note to the record and hand off to Mina to generate the promo.

Attachment: [attachment: approval-note.txt (text/plain)]

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Community | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2026 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Approved: OpenMap pooled credits and next steps

Hi Samira — good news: Marissa approved the grant with the two-tranche recommendation. We can proceed with a pooled promo code + shared billing account for the cohort.

What we'll do now:
- Issue 1.0M token-equivalent credits today as a pooled promo code you can distribute to contributors.
- Save 0.5M as a top-up; we'll add it after a brief usage check (expected ~30 days).
- You will get a read-only link to the pooled account in our console and one promo code that maps to the pool.

Action items for you:
1) Confirm the email address to register the pooled account (we've defaulted to ops@openmap.org).
2) We'll need a 1-paragraph intended-use blurb for the post-mortem (for our records).

Provisioning details:
- Portal link: https://console.redwood.ai/self-serve/credits?ref=oss-grant-2026
- Promo code: (will be generated and sent in a follow-up email from billing@redwood.com)
- Ticket: RDW-OSS-3219

Attachment: [attachment: credits-alloc.csv (text/csv)]

I'll follow up once the promo code is created. Congrats to the cohort — excited to see what contributors build.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
